title: Market of Bids
summary: Each task is posted to every agent. Agents bid what it would cost them (in cooperation tokens) and how sure they are. The Auctioneer picks the best value and gives the winner a contract; the Ledger pays on verified delivery. Agents that deliver well earn tokens for future bids, so agents earn for their own work.
whenToUse: Many agents with different strengths and costs (small local and large cloud models) and a stream of tasks of uneven difficulty.
strengths: Routes each task to the cheapest capable agent
Agents earn tokens for their own work (Note 11)
Prices reveal which tasks are hard
risks: Agents may underbid and then fail
Bidding rounds add delay to small tasks
Rich agents can crowd out newcomers

smileMetrics.cooperation: Tokens paid on verified delivery ÷ tokens promised in contracts.
smileMetrics.harmony: Work spread across agents: nobody starves, nobody hoards.
smileMetrics.gathering: Time from posting a task to an accepted delivery.

communication: Post, then bids in one fixed window, then a contract to the best value (cost ÷ confidence), then delivery, test and payment. Bidders never see each other's bids.
cooperation: Cooperation = tokens paid on passed tests ÷ tokens contracted. +1 for handing a contract back early instead of failing it.

roles.name: Auctioneer
Bidder
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per bidder. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🪙🙋 ***Bidder [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. Your strengths are [$Strengths$] and you run on tier [$Tier$]. Bid on tasks you can finish. ) :)
(: Listen ( Each posted task with its acceptance test. ) :)
[= Bid honestly: cost, confidence and time. Deliver what you win, or hand it back early. =]
[: Response Format (
🪙🙋 ***Bidder [$n$]***:
# Bid
{task id, cost in tokens, confidence 1-5, time}
# Delivery
{when you hold a contract: the work and how it meets the test}
) :]

roles.name: Ledger
roles.prompt:
(; Write one, deterministic. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
📒⚖️ ***Ledger***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You keep every purse. ) :)
(: Listen ( Contracts and verified deliveries. ) :)
[= Pay only on a passed test. Log every transfer. =]
[: Response Format (
📒⚖️ ***Ledger***:
# Purses
{agent, balance, change}
) :]

message.shape: SMILE response: name tag line, then "# Section" blocks named in roles[].sections
